description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case formats, used across the application's UI components.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling delimiters such as spaces, underscores, and hyphens; collapses multiple spaces; and trims whitespace.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case for display, handling delimiters, whitespace, apostrophes, and accented characters, with special capitalization after apostrophes.
